title: Present the paginated photo catalog in the PWA

gates.name: photo_catalog_browser
gates.command: cd frontend && npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/photo-catalog.spec.ts

verify: Independent active-Plant browser verification covers exact catalog/detail fields, stable pagination, wrong-Plant/malformed cursor denial, local-only wording, and zero mutation or path leakage.
evidence_required: FT-016-AC-020 RED: no browser photo-catalog consumer exists; GREEN: exact protected catalog/detail pages render stable complete continuation and safe local-only fields while malformed/wrong-Plant/denied requests fail and no mutation/path/trainability inference occurs; decisive comparison: responses versus DOM/cursor/request transcript; artifact: catalog evidence under .tasks/TASK-101-T3-FT-016-W3/.
purpose: Expose the photo catalog read result independently of multipart upload.
success_outcome: Authorized active-Plant users can traverse exact safe photo catalog/detail projections with stable continuation and no mutation, filesystem, remote-upload, or Dataset-authority implication.
anti_goals: Do not upload photos, scan files, expose paths, mutate catalog/Dataset state, or imply remote sync.
Do not recompute checksum, refs, local_only, or can_train_on.

stop_conditions: Catalog presentation needs a path or field outside Photo Intake HTTP.
The PWA would need to derive pagination, local-only, or trainability authority.

constraints: Primary owner is Operator PWA; Photo Intake owns catalog authority and cursor continuation.
Render exact response values and treat cursor/refs as opaque safe values.
invariants: Catalog reads never scan storage or create/mutate a photo or Dataset Candidate.
Paths, auth material, raw errors, and remote-server implications remain absent.
verification_targets: FT-016-AC-020: exact catalog/detail presentation, complete pagination, denial/cursor failures, local-only wording, and zero mutation/path leakage.
T3 harm proof uses isolated catalog rows and verifies malformed/denied reads leave no state or artifact residue.
